GRADE 6 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Invertebrates in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify common invertebrates in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

2. About Invertebrates around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. practise precautions in handling invertebrates,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

3. About Invertebrates in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the general characteristics of invertebrates,
   B. Learners should ignore Invertebrates completely.
   C. Invertebrates is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Invertebrates.

5. About Change of State in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

6. About Change of State around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the applications of the change of state of matter in everyday life,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

7. About Change of State in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the changes of state when substances are heated or cooled,
   B. Learners should ignore Change of State completely.
   C. Change of State is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Change of State.

9. About Composition of Air in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the components of air,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

10. About Composition of Air around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. outline uses of the different components of air,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

11. About Composition of Air in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of air pollution in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Composition of Air completely.
   C. Composition of Air is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Composition of Air.

13. About Light in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate the movement of light through materials,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

14. About Light around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. draw ray diagrams of images formed in plane mirrors,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

15. About Light in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the formation of shadows and eclipses in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

17. About Levers as simple machines in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify common levers used in day- to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

18. About Levers as simple machines around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe parts of a lever as used in making work easier,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

19. About Levers as simple machines in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. classify levers into the three classes,
   B. Learners should ignore Levers as simple machines completely.
   C. Levers as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Levers as simple machines.

21. About Slopes as simple machines in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify types of slopes used as simple machines,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

22. About Slopes as simple machines around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate how a slope makes work easier in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

23. About Slopes as simple machines in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify types of slopes used as simple machines,
   B. Learners should ignore Slopes as simple machines completely.
   C. Slopes as simple machines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Slopes as simple machines.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Invertebrates in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Change of State in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Composition of Air in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Light in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Levers as simple machines in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Slopes as simple machines in your school compound.
